// Fixture for app_check rule raw-string (not compiled): the allowed forms.
// The test places it at lib/features/today/presentation/ok_screen.dart and
// expects no violation at all.
import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

/// Doc comments may quote code: `Text('Not code')`.
class OkScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const OkScreen({super.key});

  static const _restorationId = 'today_list';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = context.l10n;
    // A comment with Text('Not code either') is not code.
    final notAWidget = "Text('inside a string')";
    return Column(
      children: [
        Text(l10n.tabToday),
        Text(context.l10n.greeting(name)),
        Text('$count'),
        Text('${entry.kcal} / ${target.kcal}'),
        Text(' · '),
        Text('42'),
        Text(''),
        Text('\n'),
        Text(DateFormat('yMMMd').format(day)),
        Text(l10n.items, key: const ValueKey('items')),
        Text(names.join(', ')),
        Text(isOn ? l10n.on : l10n.off),
        Text(l10n.title, style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Roboto')),
        Text('Debug build'), // app-check: allow raw-string developer-only banner
        Image.asset('assets/logo.png'),
        TextField(focusNode: FocusNode(debugLabel: 'Search field')),
        AppBar(title: Text(l10n.tabToday)),
        ListTile(title: Text(l10n.row), subtitle: Text('${l10n.kcal}')),
        Tooltip(message: l10n.tip, child: icon),
        InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.name, hintText: '${l10n.example} 70'),
      ],
    );
  }
}
